audit_qualifications: These are measurement-derived intracellular-content estimates, not directly reported mg/gDW assays, point fermentation titres, gross biosynthetic fluxes, or model fits. Lycopene is an intermediate in the CrtE/CrtYB/CrtI beta-carotene pathway.

All six conditions are retained. Existing author replicate filtering is preserved; no new sample or condition exclusions, label variants, hypothesis selection, parameter fits, or performance comparisons were made.

An earlier condition curator accidentally saw rate values after model freeze; the incident values were not used or reproduced in condition curation or passed into estimator training/prediction. Independent input verification does not restore that curator's blindness. Fully blinded operator knowledge is not claimed.

Estimator training and all three predictions remain frozen and product-outcome-blind as authorized/reported. The label curator accessed outcomes only in the authorized scoring-data phase and did not inspect sealed prediction values. Hash equality verifies artifact integrity, not historical operator blindness.
source.authority: Elizondo and Saa (2025) primary intracellular-carotenoid HPLC experiment and author-released raw measurements and measurement-summary workbooks
source.label_estimator: Author mean extracted-lycopene concentration in mg/L of fermentation broth divided by (author mean OD600 times author measured (gDCW/L)/OD600 conversion factor). One ratio-of-author-means rule for all six; no Monte Carlo or kinetic-model output is used as a label.
source.outcome_projection: All six fixed conditions; intracellular lycopene measured by HPLC, normalized to dry-cell mass. This is an outcome-data projection, not the condition, chemistry, training, or model-prediction asset.
